third_party_rules.message_regex: scipy\.optimize\x3a The `disp` and `iprint` options of the L-BFGS-B solver are deprecated and will be removed in SciPy 1\.18\.0\.
third_party_rules.message_literal: scipy.optimize: The `disp` and `iprint` options of the L-BFGS-B solver are deprecated and will be removed in SciPy 1.18.0.
third_party_rules.reason: scikit-learn 1.7.0's lbfgs logistic solver still passes the SciPy 1.16 L-BFGS-B `disp`/`iprint` options that SciPy deprecates for removal in 1.18.0; the warning is emitted by every logistic fit (the R5 supervised ladder, the R6/R6.1 regime studies and the pipeline S09/S10 stages). It is third-party code the repository cannot change without forking scikit-learn.
third_party_rules.expiry_or_removal_condition: Remove the rule when the installed scikit-learn stops passing `disp`/`iprint` to scipy.optimize.minimize (scikit-learn >= 1.8 is expected to drop them) or when SciPy >= 1.18.0 is installed (the options are gone and the warning can no longer fire). The rule is exact: a different message, category, or module is NOT suppressed and fails the suite.
third_party_rules.note_on_colon: pytest splits an ini filterwarnings rule on ':' (action:message:category:module:lineno), so the literal colon after 'scipy.optimize' is written as the regex hex escape \x3a (TOML `\\x3a`); the regex is matched at the start of the message, case-insensitively, by the warnings module.
